name: The Outlets at Orange
description: The Outlets at Orange is Southern California's premier open-air outlet shopping destination, featuring designer and brand-name stores offering significant savings on fashion, home goods, and more. Located in the heart of Orange County, this vibrant outlet center combines value shopping with a dynamic entertainment and dining experience in a convenient outdoor setting.
summary: Southern California's premier open-air outlet shopping center offering designer brands at discount prices with dining and entertainment in Orange County.
